economy.summary: His campaign says he understands how the rising cost of everything from groceries to gasoline strains family budgets, and he says he fully supports raising Pennsylvania's minimum wage, which has stayed at $7.25 an hour since 2009.
economy.short: Cites strained family budgets; supports raising the minimum wage.

taxes.summary: Says a natural gas extraction fee is long overdue and could significantly lower school taxes for local homeowners.
taxes.short: Supports a natural gas extraction fee to lower school taxes.

abortion.summary: Says he stands in support of women and will fight for their right to access the reproductive healthcare they need, including access to abortion.
abortion.short: Supports the right to access abortion and reproductive care.

education.summary: His campaign cites increasing funding for Bucks County Public Schools by nearly $17 million without raising taxes, and says college education must remain affordable.
education.short: Cites increased school funding; supports keeping college affordable.

healthcare.summary: Says no one should be forced to choose between bankruptcy and untreated illness, and advocates for access to affordable healthcare, including mental health services.
healthcare.short: Advocates affordable healthcare access, including mental health services.

energy.summary: Says everyone has a right to clean air and pure water, supports investment in green jobs, and says he placed guardrails on AI data centers to limit corporate pollution.
energy.short: Backs environmental protection, green jobs, AI data-center guardrails.

guns.summary: Says he believes in the right to responsibly own guns and supports training courses on appropriate use, safe handling, and safe storage.
guns.short: Backs responsible gun ownership plus safety-training courses.

economy.summary: His campaign says he will make life more affordable through common-sense fiscal discipline that spends only what the state has, and work to attract good jobs so families can achieve financial security.
economy.short: Backs fiscal discipline, limited spending, and attracting good jobs.

education.summary: His campaign says he will improve education through accountability, investment, and choice so students are prepared for whatever path they choose.
education.short: Supports education accountability, investment, and choice.

healthcare.summary: His campaign says he will reduce healthcare costs and increase accessibility to quality care, citing his experience as a nurse.
healthcare.short: Supports reducing healthcare costs and increasing access to care.

guns.summary: His campaign says he will keep families safe by supporting police and emergency responders and bringing residents and law enforcement together to meet shared goals; his site does not detail a firearms position.
guns.short: Supports police and emergency responders; keeping families safe.
